text: 下面进入大作文 04 · 社会公德与协同互助：风雨撑伞与爱心接力，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 物称与 cornerstone】改写“画中路人在雨中撑伞帮人过街，互助是和谐社会的基石”：

The heartwarming cartoon vividly depicts several passersby holding a shared umbrella in heavy rain, helping a pedestrian walk safely. Mutual help and collective goodwill serve as a vital cornerstone of a harmonious society.
手术刀点拨：holding... helping... 连续分层挂载动作，serve as a vital cornerstone 替代 is very important。
【二段 · 冷漠 vs 团结】用 whereas 对比“自私冷漠孤立人心，合作营造互信”，再加上一句 anything but：
Selfish indifference isolates hearts and breeds distrust, whereas cooperative action fosters mutual trust, as living without empathy is anything but pleasant.
手术刀点拨：isolates vs fosters 精准动词形成强对称，anything but 强化冷漠社会的不可取。
【例子 + 尾段】遇到公德主题怕说理太空？立刻插一句“邻里志愿者”例子并用 Only when 收尾：
A vivid case in point is the rise of neighborhood volunteer teams during severe weather. Only when every citizen extends a helping hand can we build a society brimming with genuine warmth.
手术刀点拨：A vivid case in point is... demonstrating that... 是二段救命例证积木，写实又紧扣题旨。
